description: Returns global market risk index 0-100 with list of active geopolitical crises and current market regime (BULL/BEAR/SIDEWAYS/CRISIS). Score: 0-30=CALM, 30-50=MODERATE, 50-70=ELEVATED, 70-100=CRITICAL. Also returns per-region scores for Middle East, Europe, Asia, Americas. Updated every 30 minutes. FREE - no API key required.
name: get_risk_index
